content.text: Zodiac Sun SignsThe part of astrology that you’re probably most familiar with is the Sun Sign. When you say “I am a Pisces”, you are referring to your Sun Sign being in Pisces.It corresponds to the zodiac sign the Sun appeared to be in front of when you are born. Because the Earth completes one revolution around the Sun each year, the Sun moves through all the Zodiac Sun Signs in the same order every year. For example, everyone born right before the Spring Equinox (currently in early March) is always a Pisces.*Note that there is an offset between Sun Signs in the Tropical and Sidereal zodiacs; we use the Tropical zodiac.AriesMarch 20 to April 19 for 2026TaurusApril 19 to May 20 for 2026GeminiMay 20 to June 21 for 2026CancerJune 21 to July 22 for 2026LeoJuly 22 to August 22 for 2026VirgoAugust 22 to September 22 for 2026LibraSeptember 22 to October 23 for 2026ScorpioOctober 23 to November 22 for 2026SagittariusNovember 22 to December 21 for 2026CapricornDecember 21 to January 20 for 2026AquariusJanuary 19 to February 18 for 2026PiscesFebruary 18 to March 20 for 2026NEXT SECTION4rising sign ➝The rising sign is the zodiac sign that was on the eastern horizon when and where you were born.
